about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the eerie atmosphere of a psychological horror

An atmospheric psychological horror that will transport you to an enigmatic world where reality and imagination intertwine into a deadly pattern. Explore the gloomy streets of a northern town and uncover the secrets hidden in the depths of the human psyche.

About the game

The story of Nina Vetrova — a schoolgirl whose life has become a struggle against her own fears. Suffering from an unusual form of social phobia that allows her to sense danger emanating from people, she must confront not only the outside world but also the inner demons that grow more real with each passing day. To make matters worse, in the silent snowy stillness, the trace of the one who was closest to her has vanished.

Plot and Gameplay

Immerse yourself in a dark and mesmerizing story where every step reveals new secrets. In this enigmatic journey, you will delve into the depths of the human soul by communicating with unusual characters and unraveling the tangled threads of mysterious events.

The unusual characters you meet along the way keep their own secrets. Their stories intertwine with your own, creating a complex mosaic of events that must be pieced together.

Stress-induced hallucinations and manifestations of a severe illness add a special atmosphere to the story. They distort the perception of reality, turning each day into an unpredictable adventure where reality blends with fantasy.

Spend several days in this captivating gray world where every choice can change the course of events. Uncover the secrets hidden behind the veil of madness and discover the truth about Nina’s friend’s fate.

This journey will make you doubt everything that seemed obvious and reveal new facets of human consciousness.

Atmosphere

Grey panel buildings, snow-covered courtyards, and half-empty streets due to a raging snowstorm create an oppressive atmosphere of hopelessness. The flickering light of street lamps, creaking doors, and strange rustles in the darkness intensify feelings of paranoia and fear.

Are you ready to peer into the abyss of fear and uncertainty alongside the protagonist and unravel the mystery of her best friend’s disappearance? Welcome to a world where reality gradually ceases to be what it seems.

short_description: Immerse yourself in the gloomy atmosphere of a small northern town at the turn of the millennium, where reality intertwines with the inner demons of the main character, who suffers from a strange form of social phobia. What could have happened in this godforsaken place at the edge of the earth?
